exposure: Dual use of opium and tobacco
cohort: 1840 pregnant women (920 opium users and 920 non-users)
finding: Opium use during pregnancy, both alone and in combination with tobacco use, was associated with an increased risk of preterm delivery.
mod_finding: Opium use alone was associated with an increased risk of preterm caesarean delivery, while dual use of opium and tobacco was associated with an increased risk of preterm vaginal delivery.
